text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~! I lost~! And here I thought I'd 
win this time~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
An 80-plate difference in a conveyor belt 
sushi showdown! Guh... Spe-chan really is 
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even Tsuru-chan ate ten more plates than 
last time! I ended up pushing myself way 
too hard trying to keep up!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"! Yeah! Exactly!! ...Truth is, I actually 
increased my regular meal portions 
compared to before!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So I was feeling confident this time, 
but... Still! It means I've grown enough 
to push Spe-chan to the brink, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Keeping up this momentum, let's eat 
a lot! And run a lot!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally going to pass you from behind, 
Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, yeah! I'm not gonna lose either, 
you know~? Even in a big eating contest—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even in a race! I'm going all out to beat 
you, Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"! ...Alright, it's settled!! The next 
match will be—"
